description: This file defines the QueryResult class, which encapsulates query predicates and orderings for database query construction in the OpenMRS API module.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: A class that holds lists of predicates and orders used to build database queries.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing empty predicate and order lists.

methods.description: Adds a single order to the order list.
